# QuickKit AI — Autonomous AI Agents & Digital Workforce OS
> Website: https://quickkitai.com
> Full Technical Specification: https://quickkitai.com/llms-full.txt
> Description: QuickKit AI designs, builds, and deploys custom AI agents and virtual employees to automate sales, customer support, lead qualification, and business workflows globally. Free to start with rapid 3-day implementation.

## Overview
QuickKit AI operates as an advanced autonomous agentic platform. Rather than simple trigger-based rules (like legacy Zapier zaps), QuickKit AI deploys multi-agent systems that reason, process context, interact with databases, and execute tasks across external APIs and CRMs 24/7.

## Core Capabilities
- **Autonomous AI Agents:** Bespoke agents for inbound lead qualification, appointment booking, and multichannel outreach.
- **AI CRM Platform:** Autonomous CRM with zero manual data entry, automated enrichment, pipeline staging, and follow-ups.
- **3-Day Rapid Implementation:** Standardized deployment methodology taking businesses from initial scoping to live production in 72 hours.
- **Multichannel Automation:** Integrations with WhatsApp, Email (SMTP/IMAP), SMS, Odoo CRM, and custom REST API webhooks.
- **ROI Guaranteed:** Automated savings calculator and transparent unit economics for small businesses through enterprise organizations.

## Target Verticals & Industry Solutions
- **Real Estate (USA & India):** Auto-qualify property buyers, scope client budgets, send WhatsApp/SMS reminders, and sync to CRM pipelines. [Details: https://quickkitai.com/solutions/real-estate]
- **E-Commerce & Retail:** Recover abandoned carts, automate order lookup, and provide 24/7 support. [Details: https://quickkitai.com/solutions/e-commerce]
- **Healthcare & Clinics:** Streamline patient intake, appointment scheduling, and FAQ assistance. [Details: https://quickkitai.com/solutions/healthcare]
- **Marketing & Agencies:** Automate client reporting, lead capture, and outreach campaigns. [Details: https://quickkitai.com/solutions/agency]
- **Travel & Hospitality:** Automated booking confirmations, inquiry management, and itinerary support. [Details: https://quickkitai.com/solutions/travel]

## Pricing & Plans
- **Starter Bridge:** $100/mo ($799 setup) — Small businesses & startups. 3-day deployment, AI Architect build, official support.
- **Pro Automation Suite:** $199/mo ($1,599 setup) — Scaling teams. Unlimited script fixes, Zapier monitoring, 24hr priority support.
- **Nexus Enterprise OS:** $299/mo ($3,499 setup) — Full infrastructure ownership, multi-agent orchestration, dedicated account architect.
